policy: Every static AI_TOOL_REGISTRY tool with write:true must appear here before merge. Classes: kernel_generated | protocol_exception | infra_coding | infra_llm | infra_search | legacy_gap. See docs/AI_TOOL_KERNEL_PARITY.md and docs/OBJECTTYPE_KERNEL.md UI and agent parity.

apply_patch.rationale: Coding-stage multi-hunk file edit; not an ObjectType domain mutation.

build_plugin.rationale: In-process plugin esbuild; authoring infra, not a kernel Record action.

coding_workspace_clear.rationale: Coding workspace retarget clear; Layer 2 infra.

coding_workspace_set.rationale: Coding workspace retarget set; Layer 2 infra.

coding_worktree_create.rationale: Tenant coding worktree create; Layer 2 infra.

coding_worktree_discard.rationale: Tenant coding worktree discard; Layer 2 infra.

coding_worktree_promote.rationale: Tenant coding worktree promote; Layer 2 infra.

create_conversation.rationale: Cutover alias to DirectConversation.start (UI createDmConversation shares the same action).

create_listing.rationale: Cutover alias: ai-tool-kernel-cutover dispatches to create_record / marketplace listing ObjectType path.

delete_file.rationale: Coding-stage filesystem delete; not a domain ObjectType mutation.

edit_file.rationale: Coding-stage filesystem edit; not a domain ObjectType mutation.

git_add.rationale: Structured git staging for coding ship; keep for repo engineering.

git_branch.rationale: Structured git branch for coding ship.

git_checkout.rationale: Structured git checkout for coding ship.

git_clone.rationale: Clone retargets coding workspace; coding infra.

git_commit.rationale: Structured git commit for coding ship.

git_push.rationale: Structured git push for coding ship; not Community catalog publish.

github_pr_create.rationale: GitHub PR for coding-stage review; Community catalog publish uses submit_community_catalog_submission / Sell UI.

github_release_create.rationale: GitHub release draft create; coding/release infra (Release ObjectType owns platform update actions).

github_repo_create.rationale: Create public repo under Connect user; coding infra.

install_plugin.rationale: Plugin discovery path + tenant install; authoring/runtime infra.

promote_support_to_card.rationale: Cutover alias to SupportTicket.promote_to_card (shared support-to-kanban service).

restart_llm.rationale: Local LLM process control; infrastructure, not a domain Record.

run_ephemeral_build.rationale: Layer 4 ephemeral npm/native build; authoring infra.

run_terminal.rationale: One-shot shell in coding root; coding infra.

scaffold_plugin.rationale: Plugin scaffold under coding root; authoring infra.

send_message.rationale: Cutover alias to DirectMessage.send (Intelligence WebSocket streaming stays a separate protocol exception).

submit_community_catalog_submission.rationale: Cutover alias to MarketplaceCatalog.submit_submission (Sell UI + generated marketplace_catalog_submit_submission); shared marketplace-catalog-submission.ts service.

write_file.rationale: Coding-stage filesystem write; not a domain ObjectType mutation.
